description: Ollama's OpenAI endpoint takes reasoning_effort (and `reasoning: {effort}`) and maps it to `think` (openai/openai.go thinkFromReasoningEffort: none→false, minimal→low, low|medium|high|max verbatim, xhigh→max; an unknown word is a 400) — research/tool-result-content/sources/ollama.txt:536-560. Until 2026-09-14 this case pinned a REFUSAL on the preset line thinking_format='none', written without a receipt (THEORY.md §3.17); the 2026-09-11 decision it recorded is reversed. A plain translation: no adaptation. Source receipt; live receipt still owed.
